newsitem.title: UK: Portsmouth & Sunderland H1 profits ease NO.
newsitem.headline: Portsmouth & Sunderland H1 profits ease NO.

text.p: NOTE -- Chairman Sir Richard Storey said the development plans for both local publishing and local retailing are on course and benefits will flow increasingly from the start of next year.
Excluding exceptional items of 0.33 million as against 0.39 million last time, underlying profit before tax was three percent below last year at 5.02 million.

The Croydon Advertiser Group was sold in December 1995 for 13 million stg. Excluding this group from last year, operating profit from publishing and printing increased by 6 percent to 3.38 million on turnover up 4 percent to 29.9 million. This growth in profit was achieved despite the ending of the contract to print the Independent at Portsmouth and in the face of much higher newsprint costs, said the group.
